about: Gitelman Legal Group works from Coney Island Avenue in Brooklyn and practises in New York and New Jersey by its own account. It publishes no roster we could read, so nobody on the site is named as an attorney in the form G5 counts.

169 reviews at 5.0. A free consultation, published. Its site is the slowest measured of the firms added in this pass on total blocking time, at 1.6 seconds of it, and it publishes no case results we could read.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.
